title: Generative AI: Prompt Templates and Reliable JSON Output
summary: Build the plumbing every LLM app needs: prompt templating, extracting JSON from messy model output, and a validate-and-retry loop.
problemStatement:
## Scenario
Your team calls an LLM and expects **structured JSON** back. Models often wrap JSON in prose or code fences, or get it wrong. You are writing the small reliability layer around the model in `llm_utils.py`. The LLM is any callable `llm(prompt: str) -> str`.

## Task
Implement:

- `render_prompt(template, variables)` - replaces every `{{name}}` placeholder (whitespace inside the braces is allowed: `{{ name }}`) with `str(variables[name])`. A placeholder with no matching variable raises `KeyError(name)`. Extra variables are ignored.
- `extract_json(text)` - returns the parsed JSON value (object or array) found in `text`. It must handle: pure JSON; JSON inside a ```` ```json ```` or plain ```` ``` ```` fence; JSON surrounded by prose. Raise `ValueError` if there is no valid JSON.
- `LLMOutputError(Exception)` - raised when the model never produces acceptable output.
- `call_with_retries(llm, prompt, validate=None, max_retries=2)` - call `llm(prompt)` and extract JSON. If extraction fails **or** `validate(obj)` returns falsy, call the model again with the original prompt followed by `"\n\nYour previous answer was invalid: <reason>. Return only valid JSON."`. Return the first valid object. Make at most `max_retries + 1` calls in total, then raise `LLMOutputError`. `max_retries < 0` raises `ValueError`. Exceptions raised by `llm` itself propagate unchanged.

requirements.title: Render prompt templates
requirements.description: {{name}} placeholders are substituted; missing variables raise KeyError.

requirements.title: Extract JSON from model text
requirements.description: Handles fences, surrounding prose and arrays; raises ValueError when absent.

requirements.title: Retry with feedback
requirements.description: Invalid output triggers another call whose prompt includes the reason.

requirements.title: Bound the retries
requirements.description: At most max_retries+1 calls, then LLMOutputError.

requirements.title: Validate with a callback
requirements.description: A falsy validate() result counts as invalid output.
